origin: Codex-style request with an image that is only a file of OpenAI (input_image with a file_id: derived from the capture by adding a user message), for a relay that can see. A relay cannot read the file, and a Claude request goes to accounts that read text only, so the relay serves and the image is left out of its request and recorded. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
